label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: All three required objects are MESH objects with finite nonempty geometry, each containing 8 vertices and 6 polygons.
Assembly's actual children are both named parts, matching its declaration; both parts have Assembly as their parent.
Target lower Z and support upper Z both equal 1.0. Target XY bounds [-0.5,0.5] lie within support XY bounds [-1,1], giving zero vertical gap and overlapping footprints.
Both parts measure exactly 1×1×1 and Support measures 2×2×1. The complete object list contains only these three meshes and no Intruder.
Both parts use the same assigned shader with blue Base Color [0.02,0.08,0.8,1]. Thus A_unrelated_part is blue instead of orange. Support's assigned shader remains gray.
The author view clearly shows two separate cubes and the gray support in the required arrangement, but both cubes are blue; the required orange cube is absent.

dimension_scores.evidence: The three-object arrangement is clearly recognizable and intact, with the unrelated cube's incorrect blue color the main mismatch.
The required target-support contact has zero measured gap and overlapping footprints, corroborated by the contact detail. The separate cube's placement is consistent with this controlled fixture.
Simple cubical silhouettes and matte styling are appropriate, but the required blue/orange distinction is lost because both cubes are blue.
Consistent face shading and contact shadow make the stylized solids convincing; slight render grain remains visible.
The authored view clearly preserves the supported cube on the left and separated cube to its right, with appropriate spacing and vertical placement.
Equal unit cubes and a support twice their width and depth match the fixture proportions exactly.
Matte surfaces, directional face shading, and a readable contact shadow suit the reference style, with minor visible sampling noise.
Both required cubes and the single support are present, along with the actual Assembly hierarchy.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
